name: URY Revision History
query:
SELECT parent AS `Document`, revision_no AS `Revision`, revision_date AS `Revision Date`, change_summary AS `Change Summary`, changed_by AS `Changed By`, approved_by AS `Approved By`, approval_date AS `Approval Date`, is_current AS `Current`
FROM `tabURY Document Revision`
WHERE (%(parent)s IS NULL OR parent = %(parent)s)
ORDER BY parent, idx
